title: DOW-UAP-D44, Range Fouler Reporting Form, Gulf of Aden, October 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified U.S. Navy Range Fouler Reporting Form detailing a UAP sighting in the Gulf of Aden in 2020.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator reported observing a round, cold object via infrared sensor over the Gulf of Aden.
incidents.quote: we tracked a round, cold object in IR traveling 319 degrees at 20 mph
